pr_title: jobs: Add tests to validate the canceled job metrics
pr_body:
Fixes: #64572

Previously, there was no testing to validate job cancelation
metrics, which was inadequate because of the potential danger
of regressing these counters. This, patch adds basic sanity
tests to validate the job cancellation metrics.

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/64574)

> Is there is a specific reason for why these tests are only for schema change jobs? I'm not saying that there should or shouldn't be but, if there is a reason, it would be worth explaining in the commit message.

No specific reason, this code is common so covering one type of cancellation covers all. I'll add that in the commit message. I did look at other tests of CANCEL JOB statements and didn't find any proper coverage on other operations.
I'm curious about the status of this PR, is it blocked on something? I can't remember.

Think it needed a re-review from now, and I forgot about it. So, I didn't remind you :( @postamar

issue_context.title: jobs: Add tests to validate the canceled job metrics
issue_context.body: Currently, there are only tests for failed and successful schema change jobs, we should add tests for failed jobs too.

review_comments: Perhaps I misunderstood the issue but is there a specific reason why you're querying the telemetry table instead of `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system.jobs WHERE status = 'canceled'`?
The intent of these changes is to only provide coverage for the telemetry. I didn't add any coverage for validating the cancelled counters for jobs.
